title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.124.0
author: Maya Thompson
description: Coordinated SDK parity and ergonomics work across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs: unify auth token refresh behavior, standardize retry/backoff semantics, stabilize streaming APIs, and apply ergonomics/API surface tweaks requested by platform teams. This PR bundles per-SDK fixes and one version bump per package to v1.124.0 to keep releases aligned. Motivation: ongoing customer feedback and internal parity audits showed small but user-visible differences between SDKs (auth retries on 401, inconsistent streaming cancellation semantics, and slightly divergent helper names). Changes include: - Auth: centralize token refresh logic so transient auth failures (expired short-lived credentials) trigger a single-refresh-and-retry path across SDKs. Reduces duplicate refresh attempts and race conditions. - Retries: unify default retryable status codes and exponential backoff jitter parameters. Expose RetryConfig with consistent fields across languages. - Streaming: fix edge-case where client-initiated cancel would not close underlying websocket/HTTP2 stream in Go and TS; add explicit stream.close() ergonomics in Python. - Ergonomics: rename a few helpers for parity (create_client -> Client.create, open_stream -> Client.stream) and add nicer TypeScript types. - Parity fixes: align error shapes and diagnostics fields used by runtime for automatic fallback. - Version bumps: bump python/typescript/go SDK versions to v1.124.0 and update changelogs. Checklist: [x] design doc reviewed (ENG-3124) [x] unit/integration tests added/updated [x] CI green (flake fix commits included) [x] docs/snippets updated (redwood-docs PR queued) Related: Linear ENG-3124, PM-4412. Release note: coordinated SDK parity release -- minor API ergonomics and bugfixes, no breaking changes for typical usage. For details see commits and per-file changes.
